newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures drift sideways, await fresh news.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures drift sideways, await fresh news.

text.p: IPE Brent and gas oil futures traded listlessly on Monday amid negative sentiment with little to stop numbers from falling for the third day running, traders said.
IPE Brent futures for August were up 11 cents at 1442 GMT, but down on an intra-day high of $18.28 a barrel reached on short covering earlier. IPE gas oil was up 75 cents at $162.75 a tonne.
In New York, front-month WTI contracts were four cents lower at $19.52 a barrel, with $19.40 pegged as the support level it would need to breach to get downward momentum.
"We're just drifting, there is nothing happening out there," said one broker.

"I would have thought there would be some upward pull in New York after the heavy fall there last week but apart from an initial flurry on the open we've seen a generally depressed picture," said another.
New York August WTI fell 79 cents on Thursday, as players liquidated long positions before markets closed for the Independence Day holiday.
London followed New York down, losing 79 cents at the end of the week, and dealers predicted further losses today.
